title: Mortgage Loan File Application Fee: Borrower Payment Terms and Payment Tool
content:
**Payment terms.** The application fee on a Mortgage Loan File is paid by the borrower personally, by card or bank debit, while the file is in processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended or clear to close, and it is booked once on the file. Where the program the file is in charges no application fee, no fee record is booked, and where a program that charges one works out an amount due of 0.00, the collection is booked at 0.00 so that the file shows the fee settled.

| Situation | What is booked on the file's fee ledger |
|---|---|
| Program charges an application fee; amount due above zero | one application fee collection for the amount due |
| Program charges an application fee; amount due works out at 0.00 | one application fee collection at 0.00, showing the fee settled |
| Program charges no application fee | no fee record |

The fee is booked once per file; the permitted statuses are processing, underwriting, conditionally approved, suspended and clear to close.

## Payment tool: `pay_application_fee_6c3f9eab`

**Capability.** The borrower personally pays the application fee on their own Mortgage Loan File. One run books one application fee collection on the loan file's up-front fee history for the amount given, charged today to the card or bank account the borrower chooses, and raises the file's balance of borrower-paid up-front fees by that amount. Afterwards the borrower and the agent can see the collection, with its amount, date and payment method, in the file's fee history.

**How it is run.** This is the customer's own tool: the agent unlocks `pay_application_fee_6c3f9eab` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it to make the payment.

**Parameters.**

1. `loan_file_id` — the reference number of the borrower's Mortgage Loan File the application fee is paid on, as returned by the loan file lookup.
2. `customer_id` — the customer reference number of the borrower who pays, as returned by the customer lookup.
3. `amount` — the application fee the borrower pays; US dollars as a number of 0.00 or more with exactly 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent, no currency symbol (0.00 records a fee settled in full by discounts).
4. `payment_method` — how the borrower pays, one of: `debit_card` (a debit card); `credit_card` (a credit card); `ach_debit` (a direct debit from a bank checking or savings account); `closing_disclosure_credit` (a credit line on the Closing Disclosure, which moves no money from the borrower and applies only when an earlier fee is credited back at closing, never when a fee is paid).

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Application fee paid: fee entry <entry id> on loan file <loan file id>, <amount> USD charged by <payment method> on <YYYY-MM-DD>.", where the entry id is the new fee entry's reference number, the amount has 2 decimals, the payment method is the value passed in and the date is today's date. Receiving this line means the application fee is booked on the file.
